description.narrative: By 2027, the country will have an effective child protection system against violence, founded on a robust legal framework, sensitive to gender-based inequalities and discrimination, and provided with human, financial and territorial capacities to prevent and respond to violence and early unions with an adaptive approach to emergencies.
